blueprints.license_notes: (c) Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG; Newsroom media package - editorial use terms. Reference only.
blueprints.accuracy_notes: Porsche AG caption 'Sketch, Porsche 911, 1963'. Measured: wheel-centre lines x=925/2332 px -> WB 1407 px; extremes over bumper guards 335..2998 px -> 2663 px; WB/L = 0.528 vs 901 brochure 2204/4135 = 0.533 and 1965 911 brochure 2211/4163 = 0.531 (within 1%). Roof-to-ground ~1270 mm at WB scale (901 brochure height 1273; 1965 911 1320 unladen) -> matches the 1963 901 prototype best. For the 1965 production car scale by WB 2211 and expect ~47 mm more body height (1320 unladen) and front bumper guards/fog lamps (not in the front sketch).
blueprints.ratio_check_vs_official: measured WB/L 0.525 vs official 2211/4163 mm = 0.531 -> -1.1% : close (1-2%)

blueprints.license_notes: (c) Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG; Newsroom media package - editorial use terms. Reference only.
blueprints.accuracy_notes: Porsche AG caption 'Sketch, Porsche 911, 1963'. Measured body width 443 px (321..764 px, mirror excluded) vs left tyre centre-line x=357.5 px; symmetric track ~370 px -> width/track 1.197 vs brochure 1600/1332 = 1.201 (901) / 1610/1337 = 1.204 (911). Shows NO bumper guards (matches 1963 prototypes). 1100x620 px only. Production SWB cars add two chrome bumper guards and two fog lamps under the bumper.

measurement_method: measured_wb_over_len = wheelbase / overall length measured in pixels on the side view (hub centres, bumper extremes); wheels auto-detected with OpenCV HoughCircles and checked on an overlay, or read manually from a 10-px gridded zoom. Typical uncertainty +/-1% (large drawings) to +/-2% (small/low-res). Compare with the sourced dimensions in ../../geometry.json.
